note: Hand-authored k0+1-4 STARTER lane agreement for MIESC's development swarm. Unlike xNinja's manifest this is NOT generated from source docs (MIESC has no gen_swarm_manifest.py yet), so provenance is 'authored', not 'generated' -- a consumer must NOT render these bindings as 'observed'. The load-bearing field for the engine is lanes[].console (lib/manifest.sh::lane_console inverts it); the charters and agent bindings are a sensible starting split for an operator to tune as the console pool settles. NOT the product's own model policy.
regenerate: hand-edit this file; keep lanes[].id + lanes[].console coherent with console-registry.sh's SWARM_WT_PREFIX (MIESC-).

sources.console_to_lane: this file (authored starter -- no separate agreement doc yet)
sources.agent_roster: xcapit-swarm plugin agents (installed via the GitLab marketplace)

axes.console: which CLI/provider drives a lane at runtime (kimi=moonshot, claude=anthropic, codex=openai). The only reliable runtime signal is the [lane:<id>] commit tag -- git author may be a shared merge-readiness identity.
axes.agent: advisory primary/secondary builder agent(s) from the xcapit-swarm plugin; a starting split, not a hard binding.

consoles.charter: Orchestration, research, architecture synthesis, dispatch routing
Detection quality + false-positive reduction, grounding/RAG, reproducibility & defensive docs
Scanner/tool-adapter integration, MCP server, release readiness + GitHub Actions CI, packaging

lanes.charter: Orchestration, research, architecture synthesis, dispatch routing
Detection quality + FP reduction: tool-result adapters, RAG/grounding, the agentic quality loop; adversarial verification of findings (CONFIRMED vs FALSE-POSITIVE vs HALLUCINATION)
Scanner/tool integration: the security-tool adapters, install paths, Docker runtime, MCP server surface
Reproducibility, benchmarks, and defensive/user docs. Does NOT touch the frozen paper/benchmark artifacts (MIESC's paper-freeze gate blocks those).
Release readiness: GitHub Actions CI, packaging/publish, SBOM, reproducibility checks

consumer_contract.observed_flag: render structure as observed=false: provenance is 'authored', NOT 'generated'. Do not infer console from commit-string prefixes; read the [lane:<id>] tag -> lanes[].console.
consumer_contract.read: parse this JSON. Per lane (lanes[]): console, console_provenance, status (current|retired), backup_consoles, primary_agents, secondary_agents. To attribute a commit to a console: read its [lane:N] tag -> lanes[].console.
